In the year 2016-17, the Company filed a Special Leave Petition (SlP) in the Hon'ble Supreme Court which dismissed the SLP vide order dated September 27, 2016 on the grounds that these matters were pending before the Board for Industrial and Financial Reconstruction (BIFR), and unless payments were being made by the petitioners as directed in its interim orders @ 15 paisa per unit.
